fit_reason: Whole 2019 Subaru Crosstrek offered by a private owner in the cars-by-owner section.
findings: Light dust and a slightly dull finish on the dark grey paint along the driver side doors and rear quarter
Dust film on the front bumper and hood in the front shot
Light road dust on the lower rear bumper and black lower cladding
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crosstrek. It already looks well kept, but the dark grey paint shows some dust and a slightly flat look along the side doors and front bumper in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a wash, light buff and trim dressing, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
